/-- [core::result::{core::result::Result<T, E>}::map]:
    Source: '/rustc/library/core/src/result.rs', lines 832:4-834:53
    Name pattern: [core::result::{core::result::Result<@T, @E>}::map]
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_fun "core::result::{core::result::Result<@T, @E>}::map"]
def core.result.Result.map
  {T : Type _} {E : Type _} {U : Type _} {F : Type _}
  (opsfunctionFnOnceFTupleTUInst : core.ops.function.FnOnce F T U)
  (self : core.result.Result T E) (op : F) :
  Result (core.result.Result U E)
  := do
  let (r, b) ←
    match self with
    | core.result.Result.Ok t =>
      do
      let t1 ← opsfunctionFnOnceFTupleTUInst.call_once op t
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok t1, false)
    | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e, true)
  if b
  then ok r
  else ok r

/-- [alloc::vec::{alloc::vec::Vec<T>}::extend_desugared]: loop body 0:
    Source: '/rustc/library/alloc/src/vec/mod.rs', lines 4144:8-4158:9
    Name pattern: [alloc::vec::{alloc::vec::Vec<@T>}::extend_desugared] -/
@[rust_loop_body, rust_fun
  "alloc::vec::{alloc::vec::Vec<@T>}::extend_desugared"]
def alloc.vec.Vec.extend_desugared_loop.body
  {T : Type _} (A : Type _) {I : Type _} (coreitertraitsiteratorIteratorInst :
  core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I T) (iterator : I)
  (self : alloc.vec.Vec T) :
  Result (ControlFlow (I × (alloc.vec.Vec T)) (alloc.vec.Vec T))
  := do
  let (o, iterator1) ← coreitertraitsiteratorIteratorInst.next iterator
  match o with
  | none => ok (done self)
  | some element =>
    let len := alloc.vec.Vec.len self
    let i ← alloc.vec.Vec.capacity A self
    let self1 ←
      if len = i
      then
        do
        let (lower, _) ← coreitertraitsiteratorIteratorInst.size_hint iterator1
        let i1 ← lift (core.num.Usize.saturating_add lower 1#usize)
        alloc.vec.Vec.reserve A self i1
      else ok self
    let (p, self2) ← alloc.vec.Vec.as_mut_ptr A self1
    let p1 ← core.ptr.mut_ptr.RawPtrMutT.add p len
    core.ptr.write p1 element
    let i1 ← len + 1#usize
    let self3 ← alloc.vec.Vec.set_len A self2 i1
    ok (cont (iterator1, self3))

  {T : Type _} (A : Type _) {I : Type _} (coreitertraitsiteratorIteratorInst :
  core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I T) (iterator : I)

  (self : ipext.Ipv6AddrRange) (other : ipext.Ipv6AddrRange) :
  Result (Option Ordering)
  := do

  ok (some o)

def ipext.Ipv4AddrRange.count_u64
  (self : ipext.Ipv4AddrRange) : Result Std.U64 := do
  let o ←
    core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialOrdIpv4Addr.partial_cmp
      self.start self.end
  match o with
  | none => ok 0#u64
  | some o1 =>
    match o1 with
    | Ordering.lt =>
      let count ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpSubIpv4AddrU32.saturating_sub
          self.end self.start
      let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 count)
      i + 1#u64
    | Ordering.eq => ok 1#u64
    | Ordering.gt => ok 0#u64

def ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.can_count_u128
  (self : ipext.Ipv6AddrRange) : Result Bool := do
  let ia ←
    ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.new 0#u16 0#u16 0#u16 0#u16 0#u16 0#u16
      0#u16 0#u16
  let b ←
    core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default
      core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqIpv6Addr self.start ia
  if b
  then ok true
  else
    let ia1 ←
      ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.new 65535#u16 65535#u16 65535#u16
        65535#u16 65535#u16 65535#u16 65535#u16 65535#u16
    core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default
      core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqIpv6Addr self.end ia1

/-- [ipnet::ipext::{impl core::iter::traits::iterator::Iterator<core::net::ip_addr::Ipv6Addr> for ipnet::ipext::Ipv6AddrRange}::next]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipext.rs', lines 567:4-579:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorIpv6Addr.next
  (self : ipext.Ipv6AddrRange) :
  Result ((Option ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr) × ipext.Ipv6AddrRange)
  := do
  let o ←
    core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialOrdIpv6Addr.partial_cmp
      self.start self.end
  match o with
  | none => ok (none, self)
  | some o1 =>
    match o1 with
    | Ordering.lt =>
      let next ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.add_one self.start
      let (ia, ia1) := core.mem.replace self.start next
      ok (some ia, { self with start := ia1 })
    | Ordering.eq =>
      let (_, ia) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero self.end
      let (ia1, ia2) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_one self.start
      ok (some ia1, { start := ia2, «end» := ia })
    | Ordering.gt => ok (none, self)

    Visibility: public -/
def ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorIpv6Addr.count
  (self : ipext.Ipv6AddrRange) : Result Std.Usize := do
  let count ← ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.count_u128 self
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U128 core.legacy_int_modules.usize.MAX)
  if count <= i
  then ok (UScalar.cast .Usize count)
  else
    let i1 ← core.legacy_int_modules.usize.MAX + 1#usize
    let i2 ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize count)
    i1 + i2

/-- [ipnet::ipext::{impl core::iter::traits::iterator::Iterator<core::net::ip_addr::Ipv6Addr> for ipnet::ipext::Ipv6AddrRange}::nth]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipext.rs', lines 612:4-635:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorIpv6Addr.nth
  (self : ipext.Ipv6AddrRange) (n : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Option ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr) × ipext.Ipv6AddrRange)
  := do
  let n1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U128 n)
  let b ← ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.can_count_u128 self
  if b
  then
    let count ← ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.count_u128 self
    if n1 >= count
    then
      let (_, ia) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero self.end
      let (_, ia1) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_one self.start
      ok (none, { start := ia1, «end» := ia })
    else
      let i ← count - 1#u128
      if n1 = i
      then
        let (_, ia) ←
          core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_one
            self.start
        let (ia1, ia2) ←
          core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero
            self.end
        ok (some ia1, { start := ia, «end» := ia2 })
      else
        let nth ←
          core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpAddU128Ipv6Addr.saturating_add
            self.start n1
        let ia ← core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.add_one nth
        ok (some nth, { self with start := ia })
  else
    let nth ←
      core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpAddU128Ipv6Addr.saturating_add
        self.start n1
    let ia ← core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.add_one nth
    ok (some nth, { self with start := ia })

/-- [ipnet::ipext::{impl core::iter::traits::iterator::Iterator<core::net::ip_addr::Ipv4Addr> for ipnet::ipext::Ipv4AddrRange}::nth]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipext.rs', lines 536:4-551:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipext.Ipv4AddrRange.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorIpv4Addr.nth
  (self : ipext.Ipv4AddrRange) (n : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Option ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr) × ipext.Ipv4AddrRange)
  := do
  let n1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 n)
  let count ← ipext.Ipv4AddrRange.count_u64 self
  if n1 >= count
  then
    let (_, ia) ←
      core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero self.end
    let (_, ia1) ←
      core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_one self.start
    ok (none, { start := ia1, «end» := ia })
  else
    let i ← count - 1#u64
    if n1 = i
    then
      let (_, ia) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_one self.start
      let (ia1, ia2) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero self.end
      ok (some ia1, { start := ia, «end» := ia2 })
    else
      let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 n1)
      let nth ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpAddU32Ipv4Addr.saturating_add
          self.start i1
      let ia ← core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.add_one nth
      ok (some nth, { self with start := ia })

/-- [ipnet::ipext::{impl core::iter::traits::iterator::Iterator<core::net::ip_addr::IpAddr> for ipnet::ipext::IpAddrRange}::nth]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipext.rs', lines 461:4-466:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipext.IpAddrRange.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorIpAddr.nth
  (self : ipext.IpAddrRange) (n : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Option core.net.ip_addr.IpAddr) × ipext.IpAddrRange)
  := do
  match self with
  | ipext.IpAddrRange.V4 a =>
    let (o, a1) ←
      ipext.Ipv4AddrRange.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorIpv4Addr.nth a n
    let o1 ←
      core.option.Option.map P.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleIpv4AddrIpAddr o
        (core.net.ip_addr.IpAddr.V4.constructor)
    ok (o1, ipext.IpAddrRange.V4 a1)
  | ipext.IpAddrRange.V6 a =>
    let (o, a1) ←
      ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorIpv6Addr.nth a n

def ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorIpv6Addr.size_hint
  (self : ipext.Ipv6AddrRange) : Result (Std.Usize × (Option Std.Usize)) := do
  let b ← ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.can_count_u128 self
  if b
  then
    let count ← ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.count_u128 self
    let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U128 core.legacy_int_modules.usize.MAX)
    if count > i
    then ok (core.legacy_int_modules.usize.MAX, none)
    else let count1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize count)
         ok (count1, some count1)
  else ok (core.legacy_int_modules.usize.MAX, none)

/-- [ipnet::ipext::{impl core::iter::traits::double_ended::DoubleEndedIterator<core::net::ip_addr::Ipv6Addr> for ipnet::ipext::Ipv6AddrRange}::next_back]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipext.rs', lines 700:4-712:5
    Visibility: public -/
def
  ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.Insts.CoreIterTraitsDouble_endedDoubleEndedIteratorIpv6Addr.next_back
  (self : ipext.Ipv6AddrRange) :
  Result ((Option ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr) × ipext.Ipv6AddrRange)
  := do
  let o ←
    core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialOrdIpv6Addr.partial_cmp
      self.start self.end
  match o with
  | none => ok (none, self)
  | some o1 =>
    match o1 with
    | Ordering.lt =>
      let next_back ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.sub_one self.end
      let (ia, ia1) := core.mem.replace self.end next_back
      ok (some ia, { self with «end» := ia1 })
    | Ordering.eq =>
      let (_, ia) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero self.end
      let (ia1, ia2) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_one self.start
      ok (some ia1, { start := ia2, «end» := ia })
    | Ordering.gt => ok (none, self)

/-- [ipnet::ipext::{impl core::iter::traits::double_ended::DoubleEndedIterator<core::net::ip_addr::Ipv6Addr> for ipnet::ipext::Ipv6AddrRange}::nth_back]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipext.rs', lines 713:4-737:5
    Visibility: public -/
def
  ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.Insts.CoreIterTraitsDouble_endedDoubleEndedIteratorIpv6Addr.nth_back
  (self : ipext.Ipv6AddrRange) (n : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Option ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr) × ipext.Ipv6AddrRange)
  := do
  let n1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U128 n)
  let b ← ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.can_count_u128 self
  if b
  then
    let count ← ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.count_u128 self
    if n1 >= count
    then
      let (_, ia) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero self.end
      let (_, ia1) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_one self.start
      ok (none, { start := ia1, «end» := ia })
    else
      let i ← count - 1#u128
      if n1 = i
      then
        let (_, ia) ←
          core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero
            self.end
        let (ia1, ia2) ←
          core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_one
            self.start
        ok (some ia1, { start := ia2, «end» := ia })
      else
        let nth_back ←
          core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpSubU128Ipv6Addr.saturating_sub
            self.end n1
        let ia ←
          core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.sub_one nth_back
        ok (some nth_back, { self with «end» := ia })
  else
    let nth_back ←
      core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpSubU128Ipv6Addr.saturating_sub
        self.end n1
    let ia ← core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.sub_one nth_back
    ok (some nth_back, { self with «end» := ia })

        ipnet.Ipv4Net.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqIpv4Net.eq __self_0 __arg1_0
      | ipnet.IpNet.V6 _ => fail panic

      match other with
      | ipnet.IpNet.V4 _ => fail panic
      | ipnet.IpNet.V6 __arg1_0 =>
        ipnet.Ipv6Net.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqIpv6Net.eq __self_0 __arg1_0
  else ok false

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::{ipnet::ipnet::IpNet}::new]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 149:4-154:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipnet.IpNet.new
  (ip : core.net.ip_addr.IpAddr) (prefix_len : Std.U8) :
  Result (core.result.Result ipnet.IpNet ipnet.PrefixLenError)
  := do
  match ip with
  | core.net.ip_addr.IpAddr.V4 a =>
    let r ← ipnet.Ipv4Net.new a prefix_len
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let «in» ←
        core.convert.IntoFrom.into ipnet.IpNet.Insts.CoreConvertFromIpv4Net val
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok «in»)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
        ipnet.IpNet (core.convert.FromSame ipnet.PrefixLenError) residual
  | core.net.ip_addr.IpAddr.V6 a =>
    let r ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.new a prefix_len
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let «in» ←
        core.convert.IntoFrom.into ipnet.IpNet.Insts.CoreConvertFromIpv6Net val
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok «in»)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
        ipnet.IpNet (core.convert.FromSame ipnet.PrefixLenError) residual

/-- [ipnet::mask::ipv6_mask_to_prefix]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/mask.rs', lines 37:0-46:1
    Visibility: public -/
def mask.ipv6_mask_to_prefix
  (mask1 : ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr) :
  Result (core.result.Result Std.U8 ipnet.PrefixLenError)
  := do
  let mask2 ← U128.Insts.CoreConvertFromIpv6Addr.from mask1
  let «prefix» ← core.num.U128.leading_ones mask2
  let o ← core.num.U128.checked_shl mask2 «prefix»
  let i ← lift (core.option.Option.unwrap_or o 0#u128)
  if i = 0#u128
  then let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 «prefix»)
       ok (core.result.Result.Ok i1)
  else ok (core.result.Result.Err ())

  (mask1 : core.net.ip_addr.IpAddr) :
  Result (core.result.Result Std.U8 ipnet.PrefixLenError)

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::{ipnet::ipnet::IpNet}::with_netmask]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 202:4-205:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipnet.IpNet.with_netmask
  (ip : core.net.ip_addr.IpAddr) (netmask : core.net.ip_addr.IpAddr) :
  Result (core.result.Result ipnet.IpNet ipnet.PrefixLenError)
  := do
  let r ← mask.ip_mask_to_prefix netmask
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val => ipnet.IpNet.new ip val
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
      ipnet.IpNet (core.convert.FromSame ipnet.PrefixLenError) residual

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::{ipnet::ipnet::Ipv6Net}::netmask_u128]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 1129:4-1131:5 -/
def ipnet.Ipv6Net.netmask_u128 (self : ipnet.Ipv6Net) : Result Std.U128 := do
  let i ← core.num.U128.max_value
  let i1 ← 128#u8 - self.prefix_len
  let i2 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i1)
  let o ← core.num.U128.checked_shl i i2
  let i3 ← core.num.U128.min_value
  ok (core.option.Option.unwrap_or o i3)

  (self : ipnet.Ipv6Net) : Result ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr := do

  let i1 ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.netmask_u128 self
  let i2 ← lift (i &&& i1)
  core.convert.IntoFrom.into
    core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreConvertFromU128 i2

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::{impl ipnet::ipnet::Contains<&'a ipnet::ipnet::Ipv6Net> for ipnet::ipnet::Ipv6Net}::contains]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 1462:4-1464:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipnet.Ipv6Net.Insts.IpnetIpnetContainsSharedAIpv6Net.contains
  (self : ipnet.Ipv6Net) (other : ipnet.Ipv6Net) : Result Bool := do
  let ia ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.network self
  let ia1 ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.network other
  let b ←
    core.cmp.PartialOrd.le.trait_default
      core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialOrdIpv6Addr ia ia1
  if b
  then
    let ia2 ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.broadcast other
    let ia3 ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.broadcast self
    core.cmp.PartialOrd.le.trait_default
      core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialOrdIpv6Addr ia2 ia3
  else ok false

def ipnet.Ipv6Net.is_sibling
  (self : ipnet.Ipv6Net) (other : ipnet.Ipv6Net) : Result Bool := do
  if self.prefix_len > 0#u8
  then
    if self.prefix_len = other.prefix_len
    then
      let o ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.supernet self
      let «in» ← core.option.Option.unwrap o
      ipnet.Ipv6Net.contains
        ipnet.Ipv6Net.Insts.IpnetIpnetContainsSharedAIpv6Net «in» other
    else ok false
  else ok false

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::{ipnet::ipnet::IpNet}::is_sibling]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 389:4-395:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipnet.IpNet.is_sibling
  (self : ipnet.IpNet) (other : ipnet.IpNet) : Result Bool := do
  match self with
  | ipnet.IpNet.V4 a =>
    match other with
    | ipnet.IpNet.V4 b => ipnet.Ipv4Net.is_sibling a b
    | ipnet.IpNet.V6 _ => ok false
  | ipnet.IpNet.V6 a =>
    match other with
    | ipnet.IpNet.V4 _ => ok false
    | ipnet.IpNet.V6 b => ipnet.Ipv6Net.is_sibling a b

  let ia1 ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.broadcast self
  ipext.Ipv6AddrRange.new ia ia1

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::{ipnet::ipnet::Ipv4Net}::hosts]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 847:4-857:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipnet.Ipv4Net.hosts
  (self : ipnet.Ipv4Net) : Result ipext.Ipv4AddrRange := do
  let start ← ipnet.Ipv4Net.network self
  let «end» ← ipnet.Ipv4Net.broadcast self
  let (start1, end1) ←
    if self.prefix_len < 31#u8
    then
      do
      let start2 ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpAddU32Ipv4Addr.saturating_add
          start 1#u32
      let end2 ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpSubU32Ipv4Addr.saturating_sub
          «end» 1#u32
      ok (start2, end2)
    else ok (start, «end»)
  ipext.Ipv4AddrRange.new start1 end1

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::{ipnet::ipnet::IpNet}::hosts]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 425:4-430:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipnet.IpNet.hosts (self : ipnet.IpNet) : Result ipext.IpAddrRange := do
  match self with
  | ipnet.IpNet.V4 a =>
    let iar ← ipnet.Ipv4Net.hosts a
    ok (ipext.IpAddrRange.V4 iar)
  | ipnet.IpNet.V6 a =>
    let iar ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.hosts a
    ok (ipext.IpAddrRange.V6 iar)

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::{ipnet::ipnet::Ipv6Net}::subnets]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 1275:4-1285:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipnet.Ipv6Net.subnets
  (self : ipnet.Ipv6Net) (new_prefix_len : Std.U8) :
  Result (core.result.Result ipnet.Ipv6Subnets ipnet.PrefixLenError)
  := do
  if self.prefix_len > new_prefix_len
  then ok (core.result.Result.Err ())
  else
    if new_prefix_len > 128#u8
    then ok (core.result.Result.Err ())
    else
      let ia ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.network self
      let ia1 ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.broadcast self
      let is ← ipnet.Ipv6Subnets.new ia ia1 new_prefix_len
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok is)

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::next_ipv6_subnet]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 1641:0-1648:1 -/
def ipnet.next_ipv6_subnet
  (start : ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr)
  («end» : ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr) (min_prefix_len : Std.U8) :
  Result ipnet.Ipv6Net
  := do
  let i ← U128.Insts.CoreConvertFromIpv6Addr.from «end»
  let i1 ← U128.Insts.CoreConvertFromIpv6Addr.from start
  let range ← i - i1
  let range_lz ← lift (core.num.U128.leading_zeros range)
  let i2 ← core.num.U128.trailing_ones range
  let i3 ← range_lz + i2
  let range_pl ←
    if i3 = core.num.U128.BITS
    then ok range_lz
    else range_lz + 1#u32
  let i4 ← core.num.U128.trailing_zeros i1
  let start_pl ← 128#u32 - i4
  let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 range_pl)
  let i6 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 start_pl)
  let i7 ← core.cmp.max core.cmp.OrdU8 i5 i6
  let new_prefix_len ← core.cmp.max core.cmp.OrdU8 i7 min_prefix_len
  let r ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.new start new_prefix_len
  core.result.Result.unwrap_without_debug r

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::{impl core::iter::traits::iterator::Iterator<ipnet::ipnet::Ipv6Net> for ipnet::ipnet::Ipv6Subnets}::next]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 1679:4-1699:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipnet.Ipv6Subnets.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorIpv6Net.next
  (self : ipnet.Ipv6Subnets) :
  Result ((Option ipnet.Ipv6Net) × ipnet.Ipv6Subnets)
  := do
  let o ←
    core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialOrdIpv6Addr.partial_cmp
      self.start self.end
  match o with
  | none => ok (none, self)
  | some o1 =>
    match o1 with
    | Ordering.lt =>
      let next ← ipnet.next_ipv6_subnet self.start self.end self.min_prefix_len
      let ia ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.broadcast next
      let ia1 ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpAddU128Ipv6Addr.saturating_add
          ia 1#u128
      let b ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqIpv6Addr.eq ia1 ia
      if b
      then
        let (_, ia2) ←
          core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero
            self.end
        ok (some next, { self with start := ia1, «end» := ia2 })
      else ok (some next, { self with start := ia1 })
    | Ordering.eq =>
      let next ← ipnet.next_ipv6_subnet self.start self.end self.min_prefix_len
      let ia ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.broadcast next
      let ia1 ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpAddU128Ipv6Addr.saturating_add
          ia 1#u128
      let (_, ia2) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero self.end
      ok (some next, { self with start := ia1, «end» := ia2 })
    | Ordering.gt => ok (none, self)

@[rust_loop_body]
def ipnet.Ipv6Net.aggregate_loop0.body
  (iter : alloc.vec.into_iter.IntoIter (Std.U128 × Std.U128))
  (merged : alloc.vec.Vec (Std.U128 × Std.U128)) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((alloc.vec.into_iter.IntoIter (Std.U128 × Std.U128)) ×
    (alloc.vec.Vec (Std.U128 × Std.U128))) (alloc.vec.Vec (Std.U128 ×
    Std.U128)))
  := do
  let (o, iter1) ← alloc.vec.into_iter.IteratorIntoIter.next iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done merged)
  | some p =>
    let (start, «end») := p
    let (s, deref_mut_back) ← lift (alloc.vec.Vec.deref_mut merged)
    let (o1, last_mut_back) ← core.slice.Slice.last_mut s
    match o1 with
    | none =>
      let s1 := last_mut_back none
      let merged1 := deref_mut_back s1
      let merged2 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push merged1 p
      ok (cont (iter1, merged2))
    | some p1 =>
      let (i, current_end) := p1
      let i1 ← lift (core.num.U128.saturating_add current_end 1#u128)
      if start <= i1
      then
        let current_end1 ← lift (core.cmp.impls.OrdU128.max current_end «end»)
        let s1 := last_mut_back (some (i, current_end1))
        let merged1 := deref_mut_back s1
        ok (cont (iter1, merged1))
      else
        let s1 := last_mut_back o1
        let merged1 := deref_mut_back s1
        let merged2 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push merged1 p
        ok (cont (iter1, merged2))

def ipnet.Ipv6Net.aggregate
  (networks : alloc.vec.Vec ipnet.Ipv6Net) :
  Result (alloc.vec.Vec ipnet.Ipv6Net)
  := do
  let b ← alloc.vec.Vec.is_empty alloc.alloc.Global networks
  if b
  then ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new ipnet.Ipv6Net)
  else
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref networks
    let i ← core.slice.Slice.iter s
    let m ←
      core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.map.default
        (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter ipnet.Ipv6Net)
        ipnet.Ipv6Net.aggregate.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleShared0Ipv6NetPairU128U128
        i ()
    let intervals ←
      core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default
        (core.iter.adapters.map.Map.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator
        (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter ipnet.Ipv6Net)
        ipnet.Ipv6Net.aggregate.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleShared0Ipv6NetPairU128U128)
        (core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec (Std.U128 × Std.U128)) m
    let (s1, deref_mut_back) ← lift (alloc.vec.Vec.deref_mut intervals)
    let s2 ←
      core.slice.Slice.sort_unstable (Pair.Insts.CoreCmpOrd core.cmp.OrdU128
        core.cmp.OrdU128) s1
    let intervals1 := deref_mut_back s2
    let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len intervals1
    let merged := alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity (Std.U128 × Std.U128) i1
    let iter ← alloc.vec.IntoIteratorVec.into_iter intervals1
    let merged1 ← ipnet.Ipv6Net.aggregate_loop0 iter merged
    let iter1 ← alloc.vec.IntoIteratorVec.into_iter merged1
    ipnet.Ipv6Net.aggregate_loop1 iter1 (alloc.vec.Vec.new ipnet.Ipv6Net)

  (self : ipnet.Ipv6Subnets) (other : ipnet.Ipv6Subnets) :
  Result Ordering
  := do

    ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreCmpOrd.cmp self.start other.start

  | Ordering.eq =>

      ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv6Addr.Insts.CoreCmpOrd.cmp self.end other.end

    | Ordering.gt => ok Ordering.gt
  | Ordering.gt => ok Ordering.gt

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::next_ipv4_subnet]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 1632:0-1639:1 -/
def ipnet.next_ipv4_subnet
  (start : ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr)
  («end» : ipnet.core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr) (min_prefix_len : Std.U8) :
  Result ipnet.Ipv4Net
  := do
  let i ← U32.Insts.CoreConvertFromIpv4Addr.from «end»
  let i1 ← U32.Insts.CoreConvertFromIpv4Addr.from start
  let range ← i - i1
  let range_lz ← lift (core.num.U32.leading_zeros range)
  let i2 ← core.num.U32.trailing_ones range
  let i3 ← range_lz + i2
  let range_pl ←
    if i3 = core.num.U32.BITS
    then ok range_lz
    else range_lz + 1#u32
  let i4 ← core.num.U32.trailing_zeros i1
  let start_pl ← 32#u32 - i4
  let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 range_pl)
  let i6 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 start_pl)
  let i7 ← core.cmp.max core.cmp.OrdU8 i5 i6
  let new_prefix_len ← core.cmp.max core.cmp.OrdU8 i7 min_prefix_len
  let r ← ipnet.Ipv4Net.new start new_prefix_len
  core.result.Result.unwrap_without_debug r

/-- [ipnet::ipnet::{impl core::iter::traits::iterator::Iterator<ipnet::ipnet::Ipv4Net> for ipnet::ipnet::Ipv4Subnets}::next]:
    Source: 'upstream/src/ipnet.rs', lines 1653:4-1673:5
    Visibility: public -/
def ipnet.Ipv4Subnets.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorIpv4Net.next
  (self : ipnet.Ipv4Subnets) :
  Result ((Option ipnet.Ipv4Net) × ipnet.Ipv4Subnets)
  := do
  let o ←
    core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialOrdIpv4Addr.partial_cmp
      self.start self.end
  match o with
  | none => ok (none, self)
  | some o1 =>
    match o1 with
    | Ordering.lt =>
      let next ← ipnet.next_ipv4_subnet self.start self.end self.min_prefix_len
      let ia ← ipnet.Ipv4Net.broadcast next
      let ia1 ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpAddU32Ipv4Addr.saturating_add
          ia 1#u32
      let b ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqIpv4Addr.eq ia1 ia
      if b
      then
        let (_, ia2) ←
          core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero
            self.end
        ok (some next, { self with start := ia1, «end» := ia2 })
      else ok (some next, { self with start := ia1 })
    | Ordering.eq =>
      let next ← ipnet.next_ipv4_subnet self.start self.end self.min_prefix_len
      let ia ← ipnet.Ipv4Net.broadcast next
      let ia1 ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpAddU32Ipv4Addr.saturating_add
          ia 1#u32
      let (_, ia2) ←
        core.net.ip_addr.Ipv4Addr.Insts.IpnetIpextIpStep.replace_zero self.end
      ok (some next, { self with start := ia1, «end» := ia2 })
    | Ordering.gt => ok (none, self)
